rationale: S-0068-04 proposes moving Nav1.6 + Kv3 to a virtual AIS instead of soma. t0075 (bio_realistic_ais_param_sweep) covers this directly: the AIS channel-set baseline includes Nav1.6 at medium density and Kv3 at medium density on the AIS, and Stage 2 axes 5 and 6 sweep AIS Nav1.6 and AIS Kv3 densities respectively across {0, low, medium, high}. The biologically-realistic AIS framing of t0075 supersedes the simpler 'just relocate Nav1.6 + Kv3' framing of S-0068-04. Rejecting as covered.
